cases.disposition_reason: showcase --page lists opens Lists through Cli.page and App::open_page in src/bin/showcase/main.rs. App::with_motion in src/bin/showcase/app.rs focuses NAV, and open_page leaves that focus in place while sync_nav selects Lists. The first screen is Navigation › Lists with Chosen: Rust and the ▎ gutter on Lists. The process is still running. finish sends Ctrl+Q. QuitKeys::classify in src/ui/leave.rs returns LeaveKey::Quit for Ctrl+Q, and the process exits 0.
cases.return_path: The Lists startup screen stays up, then finish sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: first_poll_delay in src/runtime.rs parses JUNIE_TUI_FIRST_POLL_DELAY_MS with parse and from_millis, and event_loop sleeps that duration once after the first draw, then takes the value. A launch with 80 still applies Down: the ▎ gutter moves from Lists to Trees while Navigation › Lists and Chosen: Rust stay, and the process keeps running. The non-numeric value nope fails the parse, so the delay stays unset, and Down still moves the gutter to Trees. Launches that omit the variable do the same. Showcase nav_key in src/bin/showcase/app.rs delivers Down to the nav tree while focus is NAV. Tree::on_key in src/widgets/tree.rs moves the cursor on Nav::Down. On one lists session the burst then sends Down, Down, and Up, so the gutter goes Sidebars, Tabs, then back to Sidebars, and the page stays Lists. move_to on the title bar leaves that gutter in place. wheel over the language list scrolls it, so the Sidebars row shows Kotlin while Chosen: Rust remains. resize to 100×30 is not the checkpoint size; Lists and Chosen: Rust stay and the process is running. Right is a plain key on a leaf, so nav_key calls open_page. The screen becomes Navigation › Sidebars with Branches and Tasks, and Chosen: Rust is gone. That opened page is the last action. The same session is captured at 120×40, resized to 80×24, captured, and resized back to 120×40. finish then sends Ctrl+Q. Tablepro App::new in src/bin/tablepro/app.rs focuses the connections tree. Down moves the ▎ gutter from Personal onto Local PostgreSQL. The detail stays on localhost:5432 and does not show ~/scratch.db, and the process stays running. Holla --scenario first-use opens the finder. FinderPage::on_key in src/bin/holla/screens/finder.rs steps the cursor on Down. The › mark moves from Analyze disk usage to Open btm, Search actions stays, and the process stays running. Jackin --scenario first-use with reduced motion paints Knock, knock, operator. from the first frame in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs. sequence_key in src/bin/jackin/app.rs consumes Down during Route::Intro and calls skip only for Enter or Esc. After Down the phrase and Continue stay, Current directory is absent, and the process stays running.
cases.action_sequence: On showcase --page lists, press Down. Then Down, Down, Up, move the pointer to the title bar, wheel the language list, resize to 100×30, and press Right. Capture 120×40, resize to 80×24, capture that frame, resize back to 120×40, then finish. On another lists launch set JUNIE_TUI_FIRST_POLL_DELAY_MS to 80 and press Down. On another set it to nope and press Down. On tablepro press Down. On holla --scenario first-use press Down. On jackin --scenario first-use press Down.
cases.expected_results: The first Down on lists moves the ▎ gutter from Lists to Trees and leaves Chosen: Rust. The burst ends on Navigation › Sidebars with Branches and Tasks, without Chosen: Rust, and the process is alive. The 80ms delay and the non-numeric delay both still move the gutter to Trees. Tablepro moves the gutter from Personal onto Local PostgreSQL and keeps localhost:5432. Holla moves › from Analyze disk usage to Open btm. Jackin stays on Knock, knock, operator. The checkpoints show the opened Sidebars page at 120×40 and at 80×24.
cases.forbidden_effects: The process exits during the burst. The settled Sidebars frames show Chosen: Rust. Tablepro shows ~/scratch.db after one Down. Jackin leaves the intro for Current directory on Down.
